verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every new Base44 app comes with built-in login, register, forgot-password and reset-password pages. These pages can be customized, translated and branded, and support multiple sign-up methods such as email, Google and other providers. A community report describes a registration-endpoint vulnerability that was fixed within 24 hours; it is a security caveat, not evidence that the scaffolded auth fails. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported social providers beyond Google, and independent hands-on corroboration of the scaffolded auth flows.
